title: Block Commando
keys: Keys: arrows move and aim up, Z or Space jumps, X fires, Enter starts, M mutes. Shoot the falling blocks to break them, clear rows to delete the floor, and do not get crushed.

title: Disc Fighters
keys: Keys: arrows move, Z or Space throws, X lobs, Enter starts, M mutes. Catch the disc, then tap down, forward, A for a fireball super when the meter is full. Hold B when a super hits to parry it.

title: Paper Rash
keys: Keys: up and down change lanes, left and right ride slower or faster, Z or Space throws a paper, X punches an adjacent rival, Enter starts, M mutes. Hit the mailboxes, dodge the cars.

title: Boom Balloons
keys: Keys: left and right steer, Z or Space flaps, X drops a bomb, Enter starts, M mutes. Pop every enemy balloon, but keep clear of the blast.

title: Grapple Ninja
keys: Keys: arrows move, hold Z or Space to fire the grapple at a ring ahead and above you and swing, release to launch, X slashes, Enter starts, M mutes.

title: Kung Fu Knockout
keys: Keys: arrows move, up jumps, Z or Space punches, X kicks. In the boss fight, left and right dodge, down blocks, Z jabs and X hooks when the boss is stunned. Enter starts, M mutes.

title: Maze Wrecker (Cabinet)
keys: Keys: arrows steer, Z or Space swings the hammer (smashes brick walls), X dashes, Enter starts, M mutes. Eat every pellet before the maze seals in 150 seconds — smash bricks to reroute the ghosts.

title: Maze Wrecker: Steel Yard
keys: Keys: arrows move, Z or Space swings the hammer (smash the wall in front of you or stun a patrol bot), X dashes, Enter starts, M mutes. Wrecked walls reveal dots; collect 26 before the timer seals the maze. Walls grow back.

title: Dig Up
keys: Keys: left and right walk and face, up and down climb your tunnel, Z or Space digs the tile in front, up plus Z digs the tile above you, X pumps an enemy to stun it, Enter starts, M mutes. Dirt you dig above you falls on enemies below.

title: Gridlock Grand Prix
keys: Keys: left and right change lane (one tap each), up accelerates, down brakes, Z or Space uses your one nitro, Enter starts, M mutes. Pass cars in the next lane for near misses. One crash ends the run.

title: Hop Fight
keys: Keys: Left and Right hop down the pyramid, Z (A) hops up-left, X (B) hops up-right. Diagonals (Up or Down plus Left or Right) also work. Land on cubes to claim them, hop onto your rival to knock them off. Enter starts, M mutes. Most cubes at the end wins.

title: Kong Calamity
mashup: Donkey Kong Country x Natural Disaster Survival

title: Lethal Castlevania
mashup: Symphony of the Night x Lethal Company

title: Tower of Yoshi
mashup: Super Mario World x Tower of Hell

title: Hyrule DOORS
mashup: A Link to the Past x DOORS

title: Deep Rock Dig Dug
mashup: Dig Dug x Deep Rock Galactic

title: Dress to Quest
mashup: Final Fantasy VI x Dress to Impress

title: River City Cartel
mashup: River City Ransom x crime sim

title: Maze Wrecker: Night Shift
keys: Keys: Arrows move, Z swings the hammer (smash bricks, STUN ghosts), X dashes. Enter starts, M mutes.

title: Morph Climb
keys: Keys: left and right move, Z or Space jumps (wings: hold to flap), X fires the beam, B or Shift changes form, Enter starts, M mutes. Grab a form on each floor before the layer that needs it. Lava rises from below.
